name: Interstellar Inn
detailed_description:
Welcome to "Interstellar Inn" the space hotel management simulation. In the dawn of the 23rd century, as the manager of Interstellar Inn, your job is to build, customize and manage your hotel and make it a profitable destination.

Gameplay Highlights


  • Building and Expansion: Begin with a small space station and develop it into a grand Interstellar Inn. Plan your expansion and customize your hotel to cater for various visitor types from different origins.
  • Resources: Balance your hotel's income and expenses, adjust room and shop rents and efficiently and manage utilities like energy, water, ventilation, and communications.
  • Welcoming Galactic Visitors: Host an array of visitors from Earth, Mars, Luna, and Space, with each visitor having unique wealth classes, traits, needs and requests.
  • Crew Management: Hire, train, and manage your hotel crew of various professions and manage their needs to increase their efficiencies. Crew members work on a fly in fly out basis, so you will be managing 2 separate crew shifts in your hotel.
  • Special Visitor Accommodations: Build shops and special buildings for special visitors such as Merchants or Companions who will rent these special buildings which in turn would satisfy various needs for your visitors.
  • Strategic Tourism: Sign contracts with tourism agencies from different planets (or space bases) to attract a wide variety of guests with diverse expectations. Complete agency missions to improve their contract levels which in turn would increase the number of visitors sent by those agencies.
  • Strategic Room Placement: Build your rooms considering desirability values and their proximity to other rooms. Monitor and manage desirability values of your rooms by adjusting rents, placing relevant buildings nearby or adding relevant modules to your rooms.
  • Reviews: Monitor visitor reviews for your hotel to make necessary adjustments that impacts the overall desirability of your hotel. Keep your visitors happy and review ratings high for continued success.
  • Star Ratings: Increase your Hotel Star Rating by building the prerequisite rooms and by achieving minimum required visitor ratings. With higher Hotel Star Ratings, you will be able to build more advanced rooms to serve your visitors better.
  • Events: Monitor galactic events: There are many different types of events, some are scheduled (like special holidays), some are completely random (like epidemics), and some are triggered only by player actions.

"Interstellar Inn" offers you the creative freedom to shape your space hotel and its future:

Begin your journey and become the architect of your own cosmic hospitality empire!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel i3 3210, AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Requires 720p or higher resolution and outputs 16:9 aspect only
